system.description: An aura of holy protection is created around the selected armor, increasing the Protection Value by +5. The aura also protects against magical weapons and spell effects that ignore normal armor, with Protection Value +3. This does not create armor, but blesses a suit that the dimwalker prays over, which takes on a lighter shade and begins to shine faintly. There must be existing armor or a shield for the ability to have any effect.
system.summary: Clothes the recipient in Belo Seoth's radiant supernatural armor.

powerLevels.effect: Increase the duration by 1 action round
Increase the Protection Value by another +1 (maximum +10/+8)
Increase the range by 5 meters (contact is no longer necessary)
